descriptions.w3d_clamp_service_ratio_802a36cc: Looks up the keyed service float through object +0x28/+0x80, stores it at +0xe8, and returns the original zero constant if the threshold is below it or it is below zero. Otherwise computes threshold/value, caps it successively by two incoming floats, updates +0xe8 to ratio*value and returns the ratio. Strict-less-than branches retain original unordered handling; frame reservation purpose unknown.
